# Phase Two — Twenty Improvements

1. Close the already-written `dialogFocus.js` before opening another write dependency.
2. Bind focus restoration idempotently at commerce surface creation.
3. Restore focus after native `close` and programmatic fallback close.
4. Avoid stealing focus when no launcher exists.
5. Test duplicate binding does not multiply callbacks.
6. Test `preventScroll` focus with fallback for older browsers.
7. Keep dialog lifecycle independent from purchase logic.
8. Re-run the 101-test green platform baseline after focus integration.
9. Runtime-prove launcher → dialog → close → launcher focus on mobile Chrome.
10. Read existing workspace/embed launch consumers before adding handoff UI.
11. Prefer the existing origin-checked, versioned protocol to any new message bus.
12. Add a launch helper only if actual caller ergonomics are missing.
13. Keep handoff payloads route/file descriptors only, never secrets.
14. Preserve path confinement and origin validation.
15. Record startup optimization as measured debt if safe laziness crosses legacy config/Auth boundaries.
16. Audit shared CSS for overflow and mobile sheet edge cases.
17. Keep game monetization cosmetic/content/convenience rather than competitive advantage.
18. Add premium product value only where a real handler fulfills it.
19. Check git overlap before every broad shared rewrite.
20. End with touched-file structural/readback audit and a truthful remaining-work ledger.
